posts.title: What's coming in Git 3.0
posts.description: Git 2.56.1 came out yesterday with fixes for six CVEs, and you should update. But the real news is elsewhere, at the top of the draft notes for the next release . That release will not be 2.57 but 2.98, and it is described as the antepenultimate one before Git 3.0. So: 2.98, 2.99, 3.0. posts.title: install: the cp that sets mode and owner in one go
posts.description: Open any deployment script and you will find the same four lines: mkdir -p , cp , chmod , chown . Four commands, four chances to stop halfway and leave wrong permissions. Yet there is a command doing all of it at once. The BSD man page dates it to 4.2BSD, in 1983, it is what make install has been calling ever since, and its name is so plain that nobody thinks of typing it by hand: install .
